title: BGS: arithmetic quantum chaos and spectral universality
description: Research corpus on rigorous routes to the Bohigas-Giannoni-Schmit conjecture for arithmetic and nonlinear quantum maps. Includes proofs, exact reductions, formal finite kernels, reproducible verification, counterexamples, retractions, and a consolidated manuscript. Fixed-strength microscopic BGS remains open.
